crs: TWD97 / TM2 zone 121 + TWVD 2001 height - EPSG:3826+8904 [TWGEOID2018h]
ai_model: Gemini 3.5 Flash Multimodal + Ground Photo Referee
ai_summary_zh: 【AI 3D 樹幹圓柱斷面與地面實景照片判釋】本測區（RosePark_Merged2）經 TWD97 局部裸地 DTM 分離、1.3m 胸高樹幹圓柱斷面切片（No Trunk = No Tree）與行動裝置 RTK 實景照片雙視角驗證：共確認具實體樹幹之喬木 53 棵（AI 視覺驗證 53 棵），1.3m 胸高斷面 Pratt 圓擬合平均胸徑 DBH 19.4 cm（最大胸徑 41.4 cm）、平均樹高 5.0 m、樹冠投影總面積 1,754.8 m²（已自動排除建築廊柱、街燈桿、號誌桿與圍牆結構）。
ai_summary_en: [Gemini Vision + 3D Trunk Cylinder & Ground Photo Referee] Local bare-earth DTM separation, strict 1.3m breast-height trunk cylinder slicing ('No Trunk = No Tree'), and dual-angle RTK mobile photo verification on 'RosePark_Merged2' confirmed 53 standing tree(s) (53 AI vision verified) with mean 1.3m DBH 19.4 cm (max DBH 41.4 cm via anti-webbing Pratt circle fit), mean tree height 5.0 m, and total canopy footprint 1,754.8 m² (automatically excluding building columns, lamp posts, utility poles, and walls).
